content: The Final Output: English Multi-SimLex. In order to ensure that the criterion C1 is satisfied, we consolidate and integrate the data already carefully sampled in prior work into a single, comprehensive, and representative dataset. This way, we can control for diversity, frequency, and other properties while avoiding to perform this time-consuming selection process from scratch. Note that, on the other hand, the word pairs chosen for English are scored from scratch as part of the entire Multi-SimLex annotation process, introduced later in §SECREF5.
